_provenance: Single source of truth for pick_place/pick_place_hammer scene object geometry. Previously duplicated as independent hardcoded constants in sim/scripts/run_robot129_ros_webrtc.py, ros2_ws/src/robot129_tasks/src/robot129_mtc_pick_place.cpp, tools/generate_s2_cube_candidates.py, and research/scripts/s5_pilot_hammer.py -- the hammer numbers had drifted apart between the Isaac spawn and the offline candidate-generation pilot (handle height 0.030 vs 0.040, head height 0.045 vs 0.050) before this file existed. The cube numbers agreed by luck. Isaac's spawned geometry is authoritative for any number here; the other three readers must load this file, not redeclare it.

counter._provenance: pick_place_counter scene (2026-09-23): a raised pedestal in front of the arm so the wrist camera, mounted at the real robot's hand-eye calibration (looks along the grasp direction), can see the objects from the real robot's observe pose. observe_joints_rad is OBSERVE from references/upstream/mm_system/main_ws/ed305_arm_pose.py (= grasp.py's return pose). Pedestal height chosen by FK: from that pose the camera looks 19 deg down from z=0.386 m and its optical axis crosses z=0.25 at x~0.46. Target is a standing can-like box (4 cm wide, fits the 7 cm gripper) instead of the 3.5 cm floor cube, because the real grasp.py assumes ~6 cm-thick objects (depth_offset_m=0.06).
